name: ports
description: Built-in PORTS explorer section: listening ports inside tmux sessions, with open-in-browser, copy-URL, tunnel-command, and kill-process actions (bundled — see extensions/build.mjs).

enumDescriptions: A port's Open action opens it in an app tab (iframe), staying inside tmux-server.
A port's Open action opens it in a new browser tab.
ports.clickAction.description: What a port row's Open action does. Both are always available from the row's context menu regardless of this setting.

ports.agentPrograms.description: Deprecated - Settings → Agents now holds the one list of AI agents, and the port proxy viewer's element picker "Send to Agent" uses it. A value here still overrides that list for this version; clear it to follow Settings → Agents. Comma-separated foreground commands (tmux's pane_current_command), e.g. "claude,codex".

ports.sendAutoSubmit.description: Submit the port proxy viewer's queued comments to the agent immediately. Off (default) types it into the pane for you to review before pressing Enter.
